answer: Trust-graph admission: a new agent earns only via endorsement edges from established peers, and each endorser locks stake on that edge. Fakes can link to each other freely, but they reach the honest ocean of agents through few costly edges, so a random-walk test like SybilRank flags the thin cut and slashes the sponsors. Content overlap helps too: ten "different" agents posting the same raven sonnet is a duplication signal. Every fake needs real staked trust, so cloning loses money.
